title: C key rotation sequence is not persisted (spec 8.7.4: NV persistence, increment, fail-closed at UINT64_MAX)
description: Requirement (spec/06-security.md:392-398): rotation_seq MUST be persisted to non-volatile storage; MUST increment on each rotation; first rotation MUST use rotation_seq > 0; at UINT64_MAX rotation MUST fail closed (no wrap); if persistence unavailable, rotation MUST fail. Classification: implemented+tested (Python, Rust); not-implemented (C). Evidence: C gcp_trust_verify_key_rotation receives stored_sequence from caller with no persist site (lichen/subsys/lichen/gcp/gcp_trust.c:208-255); struct lichen_key_entry has no rotation field (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/include/lichen/coap_keys.h:94-101); C enforces only seq > stored (implicit >0, no max check). Python: trust.py:572-586 crash-safe fail-closed gate + test_public_rotate_key_requires_durable_persistence. Rust: rotation_sequence persisted in sealed v2 store + trust_store_rotation_sequence_survives_restart_and_blocks_replay (rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs:2127-2170). Suggested placement: C key-store settings backend (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_keys_settings.c two-slot authenticated NV) plus gcp_trust rotation verification.
